user.title: Pick a radar sensor
user.description: Devices that expose per-target X/Y coordinate sensors (Everything Presence Lite/Pro, Screek 2A, other LD2450 firmwares). Area, floor and the number of targets each radar sees right now are shown to tell them apart (walk in front of one and reopen to check). Zones are drawn afterwards in the Radar Zones panel.

import_legacy.title: Import existing polygons
import_legacy.description: Found {count} polygon helper(s) (input_text.…_zone_polygon_N) for this sensor. Import them as include zones? The helpers are not changed or removed.

abort.no_devices: No unconfigured radar sensors with per-target X/Y entities were found.
abort.already_configured: This radar sensor is already configured.

init.title: Radar settings
init.description: Zones, exclusions and per-zone filters are edited in the Radar Zones panel in the sidebar.

data_description.reconnect_grace_s: Seconds to ignore detections after the radar comes back from unavailable. Ghost targets often appear right after a reconnect.
